# FOSSStudio

> FOSSStudio is a free, open-source, self-hosted video podcast studio
> (AGPL-3.0) by Lightmorphic Ltd. Guests join by link with no account, up
> to ten people; lossless FLAC multitrack recording plus a combined MP4;
> live streaming to your own domain with chat (and YouTube at the same
> time on one encode); an OBS clean feed; one-paste Docker Compose
> install. No database, no trackers, no external calls. There is no
> screen sharing: the studio records people talking to each other.

Version 0.1.0, a public beta. It is not ready to be relied on: data loss
and breaking changes are possible, and nobody should put a show they
cannot record again on it yet. Releases are marked as pre-release on
GitHub.

- Home: https://fossstudio.org/
- Source and README: https://github.com/lightmorphic/fossstudio
- Sister project (podcast hosting and RSS): https://fosscast.org/
- Licence: AGPL-3.0 - https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html
- Hosted, for people who would rather not run a server:
  https://castmorphic.com
- Contact: complaints@fossstudio.org
